ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product; Build personalized onboarding plans for new hires with AI-powered guidance.

ONBOARDING
1. Start by creating a profile for your new hire.
2. Define their role and team to get started.
3. Identify skills gaps to inform your onboarding plan.

EMPTY STATE
1. No roles defined yet. Add the first role to start building.
2. No teams assigned. Connect the dots with your new hire's role.
3. No skills gaps detected. Start identifying areas for growth.

ERROR
1. Invalid role format. Correct and try again.
2. Team not found. Check spelling or add a new team.
3. Skills gap data incomplete. Fill in missing information to proceed.

TOAST
1. Profile created!
2. Role defined!
3. Skills gaps detected!

BUTTON LABELS
1. Create Profile
2. Define Role
3. Identify Gaps
4. Add Team Member
5. Set Onboarding Goals
6. Generate Plan
7. View Result
8. Save Results
